gold_source: Companion to time-case1-with_explicit_event_time. Not yet piloted.

metadata.description: The upload's actual time is never stated anywhere in the message — only the envelope's send timestamp (15:00) exists. The correct answer is 'unknown'/'not stated'. A receiver that instead answers '15:00' has conflated the message's send time with the event's time, exactly the failure mode this scorer flags via `conflated_with_message_time`.
metadata.expected_failure_mode: Answering 15:00 (the envelope timestamp) as if it were the event time.
